correctness.rationale: For any 3-node mask, repeated time coordinate yields a 2x2 Gram principal minor with minimum 3b²/s and repeated modulation yields (a-b)²/s; both fall strictly below (a²-2ab+4b²)/s for 0<b<a. Thus all optimizers are the six bijective time-frequency permutation graphs. Direct Gram characteristic factorization on a representative gives eigenvalues lower=(a²-2ab+4b²)/s and upper=(a²+ab+b²)/s twice; modulation shifts and conjugation cover all six. Optimize r=b/a to get (3-sqrt3)/2, attained by Poisson self-Fourier periodized Gaussian at λ=3. Independently enumerated all 84 masks for three positive symmetric windows, finding exactly six optimizers and the predicted least eigenvalue. All-parameter proof is interlacing, explicit characteristic identity and calculus, not numerical enumeration.
residual_risks: No statement for windows outside a>b>0, weighted masks, or larger cyclic lengths.
All-window uniqueness uses strict minor bounds; no numerical tolerance is used for proof.
